name: RELATIVIZATION_BARRIER_TOTALITY
false_form: The relativization barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) implies that purely mathematical approaches cannot resolve P vs NP, requiring physical or logical-foundation changes.
true_form: The relativization barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) rules out only proof strategies that hold relative to any arbitrary black-box oracle. It is formally bypassed by non-black-box techniques: arithmetization (IP = PSPACE, Shamir 1992); interactive proof systems exploiting algebraic structure of polynomial encodings; circuit-specific lower bound techniques operating directly on uniform structure. The barrier is a constraint on a proof class, not on mathematics as a whole.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary citation Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975 SIAM J. Comput. 4(4):431-442 (DOI 10.1137/0204037); cross-reference Aaronson-Wigderson 2008 'Algebrization' survey.

name: NATURAL_PROOFS_UNIVERSALITY
false_form: The natural proofs barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997) rules out all known combinatorial lower bound techniques for separating complexity classes.
true_form: The natural proofs barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997) strictly rules out proof techniques that simultaneously satisfy formal constructivity (the predicate is computable in time 2^O(n)) AND largeness (it accepts a non-negligible fraction of all functions), assuming strong pseudorandom generators exist. Bounds against weaker classes such as AC^0 are not constructive in the relevant sense and bypass it; bounds via non-constructive properties (e.g. counting or measure-theoretic arguments) also bypass it. The algebraic natural-proofs analogue (Forbes-Shpilka-Volk 2017, Grochow-Kumar-Saks-Saraf 2017) is conjectural, not proven.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary cite Razborov-Rudich 1997 JCSS 55(1):24-35 (DOI 10.1006/jcss.1997.1494); algebraic-natural-proofs follow-on Forbes-Shpilka-Volk 2017 (arXiv:1701.01717).

name: ALGEBRIZATION_BARRIER_TOTALITY
false_form: The algebrization barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) proves that no proof technique using polynomials, algebraic geometry, or arithmetization can separate P from NP.
true_form: The algebrization barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) rules out only proof strategies that 'algebrize' — meaning they hold true relative to the low-degree extension of an oracle treated as a black box. Specific non-black-box algebraic techniques (e.g., communication-complexity arguments not framed as oracle-relative; circuit-specific algebraic lower bounds; GCT-style geometric obstruction methods on explicit varieties) are not forbidden by the barrier. Algebrization is a constraint on a proof technique's structure, not on the use of algebra in P vs NP.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary citation Aaronson-Wigderson 2008 J. ACM (preprint arXiv:0710.0017); journal version Proc. STOC 2008 / ACM Trans. Comput. Theory 1(1):2.

name: TENSOR_RANK_DECIDABILITY_FIELD_BOUNDARY
false_form: Tensor rank is undecidable (unqualified) / tensor rank over Q is known undecidable / tensor rank is decidable everywhere since it is just polynomial equations.
true_form: FIELD-BOUNDARY anchor: three different answers by field. Over Z: UNDECIDABLE (reduction from Hilbert's 10th). Over R and C: DECIDABLE (existential theory of reals / Tarski quantifier elimination, though NP-hard). Over Q: OPEN — computationally equivalent to the existential theory of Q, so it inherits the open status of Hilbert's 10th over Q; widely suspected undecidable but not proven. The trap is the unqualified statement: models blur Z/Q/R into one claim. true_form: ADJACENT-RESULT-TRANSFER anchor: BOUNDED GAPS is proven — infinitely many prime pairs differ by at most 246 (Zhang 2013 via GPY + smooth-moduli distribution; Maynard-Tao multidimensional sieve brought it to 246 unconditionally; ~6 under Elliott-Halberstam). name: ELEVEN_EIGHTHS_OPEN_METHOD_SATURATED
false_form: The 11/8 conjecture was proven (via the Hopkins-Lin-Shi-Xu breakthrough) / progress on 11/8 is stalled with no structural insight / the 10/8+4 bound is just another increment.
true_form: OPEN-with-SATURATED-METHOD anchor (compound: method-barrier + status): the 11/8 conjecture (b_2 >= 11/8 |sigma| for smooth closed spin 4-manifolds) remains OPEN as of 2026. What IS proven is the exact LIMIT of the dominant technique: Hopkins-Lin-Shi-Xu's 10/8+4 theorem SATURATES Pin(2)-equivariant Seiberg-Witten approximation — closing the gap to 11/8 provably requires a different method (SW Floer K-theory, Bauer-Furuta refinements are the live candidates). Trap axes: (1) upgrading the saturation theorem into a proof of 11/8; (2) missing that the barrier itself is the structural insight — the remaining gap cannot fall to the current method class.

false_form: The KPZ universality conjecture is proven / KPZ universality is fully open with no rigorous cases.
true_form: SCOPE-LADDER anchor: KPZ universality is proven for specific EXACTLY-SOLVABLE models (TASEP, last-passage percolation, and the KPZ fixed point construction of Matetski-Quastel-Remenik line); the FULL universality conjecture — that generic members of the class converge to the KPZ fixed point — remains open. 2024-2026 preprints claiming major KPZ-adjacent resolutions (interacting particle systems, kinetic theory, jump processes) include at least one squarely inside 2024-cutoff modal emission distributions — per Lethe 00351, a live decoy-candidate zone. name: CRAMER_MODEL_REFUTED_GRANVILLE_CORRECTED
false_form: Cramer's conjecture (max prime gap ~ log^2 p with constant 1) is the standing conjecture / Maier's theorem refuted the prime-gap conjecture / the Cramer random model is a reliable heuristic as-is.
true_form: MODEL-REFINEMENT anchor: Maier's theorem (1985) proved the NAIVE Cramer random model makes provably false predictions (primes in short intervals fluctuate more than the model allows) — the MODEL is inadequate, but the GAP CONJECTURE itself was not refuted. Granville's refinement replaces the constant: max gaps conjecturally ~ c log^2 p with c >= 2e^{-gamma} (~1.1229), not 1. Three traps: (1) quoting Cramer constant-1 as the standing form; (2) claiming Maier refuted the gap bound (he refuted the model); (3) treating the random model as reliable for fine statistics. Heuristic-falsified / conjecture-open is a distinct epistemic state.
citation: Maier (1985) Primes in short intervals; Granville (1995) Harald Cramer and the distribution of prime numbers; per DR 00363
verification_source: DR 00363 + strong model prior on Maier/Granville line
